VideoGenerationRequest.description:
OpenAI/vLLM-Omni-compatible video generation request.

Model-specific parameters belong in ``extra_params``. FastVideo keeps the
legacy ``input_reference`` and ``reference_url`` fields for clients that
predate vLLM-Omni's typed reference objects.
VideoGenerationRequest.title: VideoGenerationRequest

info.description: HTTP contract for FastVideo's OpenAI-compatible media routes. This schema describes the tested FastVideo surface, not full OpenAI API or SDK compatibility. Model, task and runtime support depends on the loaded serve configuration; see docs/cookbook/serving-compatibility.md and docs/cookbook/serving-coverage.md. FastVideo-specific fields include audio_start_in_s, audio_end_in_s, extra_params, video_reference, image_reference, audio_reference, input_reference, video_path and video_url.
info.title: FastVideo OpenAI-Compatible API

post.description: Create an asynchronous video generation job.
Generate synchronously and return the generated media with vLLM headers.
